title: Very pretty!
text:
Very pretty!. We used this as a side table for our building lobby and it looks lovely. The faux
Marble top looks real and the table is very sturdy.

product_metadata.title: Best Choice Products 36in Faux Marble Accent Table, Modern End Table, Large Coffee Table Home Decor for Living Room, Dining Room, Tea, Coffee w/Metal Frame, Foot Caps, Designer - White/Gold
features: STURDY BUILD: Legs are connected with a cross design for maximum stability under a durable, laminate faux marble table top that holds over 100 pounds, fusing durability with a modern-contemporary look
CLASSY HOME FURNITURE: Round coffee table serves as a modest yet elegant living room addition for placing magazines, snacks, beverages, or a decorative centerpiece
EASY TO CLEAN: A smooth frame and table top surface allows for effortless maintenance, so you can keep the table looking its best for years to come
PROTECTS FLOORS: Designed with non-marking foot glides, this side table protects floors from scuffs, indentations, and other potential damages

EASY ASSEMBLY: Put the table together in as little as 15 minutes with 3 easy steps: Assemble the legs, attach the table top, and turn your completed table over; OVERALL DIMENSIONS: 35.6"(Dia) x 19"(H); Weight Capacity: 110 lbs.
